> Jobs To Be Done, with the four forces of switching: push of the current situation, pull of the new, habit of the present, and anxiety about the new.
 It is the only common framework that models why a buyer with an obvious problem does nothing anyway. Habit and anxiety are the two forces our own materials never address and they are why the no-decision competitor keeps winning.
